NBSP/tab trim, 103->100 chars, cut ending in whitespace trimmed (test :104), null meta/email, scalar meta, http/javascript/uppercase dropped, 2048 kept/2049 dropped

A freshly provisioned user can create a kudo and like a kudo through the existing RPCs; the no-sunner backstop paths still work — proof: pgTAP viewer_sunner_id resolves, create_kudo stores sender = provisioned row, toggle_kudo_like returns liked; sunner_not_found cases in kudos-like-rules and write-kudo-create-rules plus feed/sidebar no-sunner in kudos-rls-and-reads still pass

findings.summary: addressed — Email sign-up enabled (confirmations off locally): the auth.users trigger at supabase/migrations/20261015035950_auto_provision_sunner.sql:42-44 now gives any anon-key /signup (non-Google, even unconfirmed) a searchable, write-capable sunner with attacker-chosen name and avatar host. Fix: [auth.email] enable_signup = false (local + hosted) or a provider = 'google' gate in provision_sunner
Avatar accepts any https host; limiting to googleusercontent closes the third-party tracking-pixel path

Pre-existing on delete set null: a deleted auth user leaves an orphan sunner and re-sign-up creates a second persona

Trigger is AFTER INSERT only, but GoTrue auto-links a Google sign-in to an existing same-email (email/password or invited) account via UPDATE of raw_app_meta_data (LinkAccount path), so that Google user never gets a sunner while the backfill would provision the same linked account; fix: after insert or update of raw_app_meta_data (function is already gated and idempotent)
